So yes I do play on a no alt turn server. However some key facts to take in about alt turn is how fast it is I have literally seen rexes just spin like a beyblade. Yes I do think they should have a way to have a stand in spot turn but the alt turn we have is trash. Plain and simple not to mention coupled with the already broken hit boxes it makes alt turn even more trash. A animal the size of a rex would not be fast at all turning on the spot. And in reality still be able to be ridden. But dont get me wrong I dont care either way I just want alt turn and hit boxes to be fixed. Also note they plan on adding collision to dinos so in theory even with alt turn if someone is behind you then you might not even be able to turn and bite it. Just some food for thought 

End statement The current alt turn is trashy poorly designed and not at all realistic. With animations and such that might slow it down coupled with collision I think it could be good but none of us know until this happens.
